usage: MergeBin.py [-h] --out_fn OUT_FN [--platform PLATFORM]
                   [--enable_dwell_time]
                   in_fn [in_fn ...]

Combine tensor binaries into a single file

positional arguments:
  in_fn                Tensor input files, required

options:
  -h, --help           show this help message and exit
  --out_fn OUT_FN      Output a binary tensor file, required
  --platform PLATFORM  Sequencing platform of the input. Options:
                       'ont,hifi,ilmn', default: ont
  --enable_dwell_time  Enable dwell time, default: False
